title: The secrets of 気: 気になる, 気にする, 気がする, 気に入る
summary: 気 is a flowing spirit. The particle shows who does what: 気になる (it occupies my spirit), 気にする (I make it so), 気がする (a feeling is active).

blocks.text: **気** is the flowing spirit in a person, close to breath, energy or mind. One end is the steady energy: **元気** (original vigor), **病気** (sick spirit). The other end is a particular will: **やる気** (a doing-spirit). 気を付ける literally attaches your spirit to something: pay attention.
The expressions are confusing until you notice that **the particles tell you who does what**.

rows: X turns into my spirit: it occupies my mind
I turn X into my spirit: I worry about it (on purpose)
a feeling is active, like a smell or a sound
X enters my spirit: I like it

blocks.en: I can't stop thinking about that person.

blocks.jp: 小さなことを気にしないで。

blocks.en: I feel like I've gotten stronger.

blocks.jp: この部屋が気に入った。

blocks.text: **気になる** is something happening to you, and can range from intrigued to worried. **気にする** is you doing it, so it tends to mean worried, and 気にしないで is a request to control it. In **気がする**, the feeling itself acts, just as いい匂いがする means a good smell is active.

items: 気: the spirit, energy or mind.
**気になる**: it occupies my mind; **気にする**: I make it my concern.
**気がする**: a feeling is active; I sense it.
**気に入る**: it enters my spirit, I like it.

questions.instruction: What does 気にしないで mean?
questions.note: Don't turn it into your concern.

questions.prompt: あの人＿＿気になる。 (That person occupies my mind.)
questions.note: The person is the A-car: the one who turns into my spirit.

questions.prompt: 小さなことを＿＿しないで。 (Don't worry about small things.)
questions.note: We make a thing into our spirit: 気にする.

questions.instruction: Which one has ME as the doer, turning something into my concern?
What does 変な気がする mean?

questions.prompt: In 気がする, the 気 (the feeling) is the one acting, like a smell or a sound.
I have a feeling that I got stronger.

questions.instruction: Tap the word meaning "spirit" in 階段に気を付けて
What does 気に入る mean?
questions.note: It enters my spirit: it suits me.

questions.prompt: この家は＿＿入った。 (I like this house.)

questions.instruction: What does 勉強する気がある mean?
questions.note: The spirit to study exists in me.
